### Loading and merging the data

```{python}
# Load data
database_url = os.getenv("DUCKDB_DB_URL")

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute("INSTALL postgres; LOAD postgres;")  
con.execute(f"ATTACH '{database_url}' AS my_db (TYPE postgres, READ_ONLY);")

dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_establishments").df()
near_dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_nearby_estabs_50mi").df()
air_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.air_quality").df()
bus_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.business_patterns").df()
code_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.naics_code_look_up").df()
gdp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.gdp").df()
inc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.personal_income").df()
pop_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.population").df()
perm_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.res_construction_permits").df()
emp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.unemployment").df()
county_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.us_counties_spatial").df()
```

### K-Means Clustering
```{python}
final_df["has_datacenter"] = final_df["datacenters"] > 0
y = np.log(final_df['datacenters'] + 1)


cols_to_drop = ["datacenters", "county_id", "year", "has_datacenter"] 
X = final_df.drop(columns=[c for c in cols_to_drop if c in final_df.columns])

X_train_raw, X_test_raw, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42)

qt = QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', random_state=42)
X_train = qt.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_test = qt.transform(X_test_raw)

pca = PCA(n_components=0.85, random_state=42)
X_train = pca.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test = pca.transform(X_test)
```

```{python}
# Plot top two PCA components lable by data center count
model_reg = LinearRegression()
model_reg.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred_num = model_reg.predict(X_test)

# Regression PCA Trainning Data
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
scatter = plt.scatter(
    X_train[:, 0],
    X_train[:, 1],
    c=y_train,
    cmap='viridis',
    edgecolors='none',
    s=20,
    alpha=0.3
)
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.title('PCA Projection of US Counties by Logged Datacenter Count')
plt.colorbar(scatter, label='Logged Datacenter Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# check performance of clustering model 
scores = {}
for k in range(2, 10, 2):
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, init='k-means++', n_init=10, random_state=42)
    labels = km.fit_predict(X_train)
    scores[k] = silhouette_score(X_train, labels)

# Plot scores
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(list(scores.keys()), list(scores.values()), marker='o')
plt.xlabel('Number of Clusters (k)')
plt.ylabel('Silhouette Score')
plt.title('Silhouette Score vs. k')
plt.show()
```

Higher Silhouette scores indicate better separate bewetween clusters and thus better performance. Score ranges from -1 to 1

```{python}
# choose number of cluters to use

```

```{python}
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters, init='k-means++', max_iter=300, n_init=10, random_state=42)

kmeans.fit(X_train)

cluster_labels = kmeans.predict(X_train)

```

```{python}
# Check which featurs are contributing most to cluster separation
X_train_df = pd.DataFrame(X_train, columns=X.columns)
X_train_df['Cluster'] = cluster_labels

# Calculate cluster means
cluster_means = X_train_df.groupby('Cluster').mean()

# Plot heatmap with  feature names
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10))
sns.heatmap(
    cluster_means.T, 
    cmap='coolwarm', 
    annot=True, 
    fmt='.2f'
)

plt.title('Cluster Profiles by Feature Means')
plt.xlabel('Cluster ID')
plt.ylabel('Features')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

silhouette_avg_train_data = silhouette_score(X_train, cluster_labels)
print(f'Train Data Silhouette Score: {silhouette_avg_train_data:.2f}')

test_cluster_labels = kmeans.predict(X_test)
silhouette_avg_test = silhouette_score(X_test, test_cluster_labels)
print(f'Test Data Silhouette Score: {silhouette_avg_test:.2f}')
```

```{python}
# save cluster lables to data frame for later use
train_clusters = kmeans.predict(X_train)
test_clusters = kmeans.predict(X_test)

kmeans_labled_df = final_df.copy()

kmeans_labled_df.loc[y_train.index, 'cluster_label'] = train_clusters
kmeans_labled_df.loc[y_test.index, 'cluster_label'] = test_clusters

kmeans_labled_df['cluster_label'] = kmeans_labled_df['cluster_label'].astype(int)
```


### Add Treatment Flag

```{python}
# create columns to track if and when a county got its first dc
first_treated = (
    final_df[final_df["datacenters"] > 2]
    .groupby("county_id")["year"]
    .min()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"year": "first_dc_year"})
)

final_df = final_df.merge(first_treated, on="county_id", how="left")
final_df["first_dc_year"] = final_df["first_dc_year"].fillna(0).astype(int)

final_df["treated"] = (
    (final_df["first_dc_year"] > 0)
    & (final_df["year"] >= final_df["first_dc_year"])
).astype(int)

# Create relative time variable: t - first_dc_year (e.g., -2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
# Set never-treated (first_dc_year == 0) relative time to -100
final_df["rel_year"] = final_df.apply(
    lambda x: x["year"] - x["first_dc_year"] if x["first_dc_year"] > 0 else -100,
    axis=1,
)

final_df = final_df.merge(
    kmeans_labled_df[["county_id", "year", "cluster_label"]],
    on=["county_id", "year"],
    how="left",
)
```

```{python}
# split dataset into only cluster 0 obersvations and only cluster 1 observations
cluster_0_df = final_df[final_df["cluster_label"] == 0]
cluster_1_df = final_df[final_df["cluster_label"] == 1]
```

#### Testing the effect adding the first DC to a county over time on personal income

```{python}

cs = CallawaySantAnna(
    control_group="never_treated",  
    estimation_method="reg",
    allow_unbalanced_panel=True
)

results = cs.fit(
    data=cluster_0_df,
    outcome="personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log",
    unit="county_id",
    time="year",
    first_treat="first_dc_year",
    covariates=[],
    aggregate="all"
)
es_df = (
    pd.DataFrame.from_dict(results.event_study_effects, orient="index")
    .sort_index()
    .loc[-5:5]
)
es_df["ci_lower"] = es_df["conf_int"].apply(lambda x: x[0])
es_df["ci_upper"] = es_df["conf_int"].apply(lambda x: x[1])

mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, "Log Personal Income per Capita")

results = cs.fit(
    data=cluster_1_df,
    outcome="personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log",
    unit="county_id",
    time="year",
    first_treat="first_dc_year",
    covariates=[],
    aggregate="all"
)
es_df = (
    pd.DataFrame.from_dict(results.event_study_effects, orient="index")
    .sort_index()
    .loc[-5:5]
)
es_df["ci_lower"] = es_df["conf_int"].apply(lambda x: x[0])
es_df["ci_upper"] = es_df["conf_int"].apply(lambda x: x[1])

mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, "Log Personal Income per Capita")
```
